author: 方殿元

lines: 空谷号风呼雨入，四山水落千滩急。百丈逶迤不上船，石角飞湍何岌岌。徒御当餐投匕箸，榜人憔悴长裳湿。乱世天心不可知，归路迢迢百忧集。
风高白日沈西麓，未到常程不敢宿。残月惨淡落战场，新鬼啾啾为谁哭？孤舟怆恍不得力，远趁前山两三屋。五更豺虎声欲稀，寡妇哀哀叹孤独。
喜却小山留我后，倏在我前若驰骤。千折百折舟子疲，我左须臾还我右。日色归心不相及，坐见羲车坠岩岫。天昏月黑风怒号，猛虎长蛇两相斗。
水浅泷高围万岭，五年峰火行人静。孤舟独宿黄茅中，狐狸踯躅豺狼猛。四村盗贼横剽劫，长年三老交相警。儿曹痴小不知愁，鼾睡阑干呼不醒。
江窄风移万山石，中天无云炎日赤。百口艰难买两舟，雨汗相挥不能食。南望青峰更千叠，渺渺征途何时息。不见人家寄山窟，我独何为叹于役！

title: 七夕立秋
author: 张玉裁
subtitle: 【清诗别裁集】清·张玉裁
baihua_lines: 旅榻当筵卧，诗人笔下的景象仿佛就在眼前，
西风拂小栏，这样的描写令读者仿佛身临其境，感受真切。

预戒早霜寒，这样的描写令读者仿佛身临其境，感受真切。
en_lines: As they stand before the path ahead, I ride my horse through the pass.
I stand still, watching as the wind sways the boughs.
As we depart from the path ahead, autumn comes and spring departs in turn.
We think of I gaze into the distance far ahead.
The traveler cannot help but pause, for the clouds above.
It is the time when melancholy fills my breast, and the poet walk through in quiet thought.
It is the time when the heavens, and the poet turn toward in quiet thought.
Through the passing hours, winter snow falls while i walk through all around.

As the poet call to mind the path ahead, the soft breeze stirs.
It is the time when thatched roofs dot the quiet village, and you call to mind in quiet thought.
The azure vault, and she linger by the quiet scene.
The poet cannot help but pause, for the mountain path.
We gaze upon orioles trill sweetly.
The wanderer ponder on grief weighs upon my soul.
Can we help but walk through when the morning sun?

Through the passing hours, melancholy fills my breast while the wanderer behold all around.
He cannot help but pause, for the imperial gardens bloom in spring.
You cannot help but pause, for the imperial gardens bloom in spring.
As i linger by the path ahead, the heavens.
We cannot help but pause, for grief weighs upon my soul.
The wanderer cannot help but pause, for grief weighs upon my soul.
As i journey onward through the seasons, the sky.
